veranderings.voor: Suid-Afrika is in nege provinsies verdeel wat elkeen sy eie regering het.
veranderings.na: Suid-Afrika is in nege provinsies verdeel, en elkeen het sy eie regering.
veranderings.rede: Two main clauses read more easily for Grade 5 than a relative clause split off from its noun by the participle; the AWS comma joins two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Die regering sit in 'n stad wat ons die provinsie se hoofstad noem.
veranderings.na: Elke provinsie se regering sit in 'n stad wat ons sy hoofstad noem.
veranderings.rede: 'Die regering' does not say which government (a learner may think of the national one); naming each province's government makes the reference clear without changing the meaning.

veranderings.voor: want daar tel die natuur en die San se rotskuns albei
veranderings.na: want dit is op die lys vir sy natuur en ook vir die San se rotskuns
veranderings.rede: 'daar tel ... albei' is vague and close to English 'both count'; repeating the paragraph's own 'op die lys vir' pattern says the same thing plainly.
An adjective cannot be joined to a name with a hyphen; the compound noun 'kultuurlandskap' is the correct Afrikaans form, and the protected name ǂKhomani with its click stays unchanged.
'stoppe' is an unusual plural and reads awkwardly; 'stopplekke' is the natural word for the stops on a route.

veranderings.voor: Noordwes, en die Pleistoseen-bewoningsterreine in die Wes-Kaap
veranderings.na: Noordwes. Die Pleistoseen-bewoningsterreine staan in die Wes-Kaap
veranderings.rede: The comma before 'en' sits between verbless parts of one long sentence, which the house AWS rule does not allow; splitting off the last part as its own sentence removes it, keeps the list clear and shortens the sentence.

vlae.rede: The established Afrikaans name is usually written 'Makapansvallei' (as in Makapansgat); it is a place name, appears twice, and was not changed here, so a person or the writer should confirm the intended spelling.

vlae.teks: 'n Wêrelderfenisterrein wat op die lys is vir mense se verlede daar. / Vier is op die lys vir hul natuur en sewe vir mense se verlede.
vlae.rede: The decided-definition note for 'gemengde wêrelderfenisterrein' says 'mense se verlede' is too narrow because the ǂKhomani site is listed for the ǂKhomani-San's living culture, yet this lesson defines a cultural site by 'mense se verlede' and puts the ǂKhomani site in that list; fixing it needs a content decision, not a language edit.
